newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso to trade around 28 to the dlr.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso to trade around 28 to the dlr.

text.p: The Philippine peso will trade around 28 to the dollar with an upward bias on Monday as exporters unload more dollars, traders said.
The peso closed at 28 on Friday.
Traders said more exporters are encouraged to sell their dollars following recent peso gains after its de facto devaluation two weeks ago.
The peso, however, could be pulled down by import demand, dealers said.
"It will be a balancing act," a foreign bank trader said.

Dealers said they expect the Philippine central bank to keep its minimal intervention stance in the market in line with its new policy to let the peso trade in a wider range to discourage speculation.
